Monologue: What interesting times we are living in, friend.
Were you curious about that doctor's findings? Hopeful that you could stop him from progressing in Spoilage?
No need to feel bad, friend. This is not the end for him, but a new beginning.
We will treat him well as one of us.
I thank you that despite the signs, you continued to serve that man until his end.
You brought peace to the dying man, and allowed his new self to be born without complications.
I don't mind if you hate me. In fact, I would prefer you do. To what order do I need to go to break your silence astounds me. A shame, really.
You see, friend, I am here to learn more about this city on behalf of my…superiors. The Spoilage here is something they are greatly interested in.
I watch, just like you, of all the folks who live and breathe in this city. When I act, it is to *experiment*.
You, my friend, are my final subject. Your silent compassion was interesting to observe.
You can return to your work in peace. This is our final goodbye, friend. There's not much left. I hope you enjoy the ride of what's left.
